reference: Independent shell assertions, a fixed Python-authored USTAR FIFO/member archive, and GNU tar decoding of pax output. No external GNU pax CLI parity is claimed.
coverage: Shared engine writer hardlinks/FIFOs and repeated archive context reset.
Independent FIFO extraction with original modes and restored umask.
exclusions: Character/block devices, copy mode, unsafe paths and concurrency are not exercised.

Distinct source inodes mapped onto one archive pathname can make a later hardlink alias bind to the replacement data, as independently observed with GNU tar. General preservation of source data/topology across conflicting archive member names is not claimed.

cases.purpose: Pax creation emits regular hardlinks and FIFO metadata readable by GNU tar; a later archive containing only an alias has its own fresh context.
cases.script:
/usr/bin/mkdir restored one-member
printf shared > original
/usr/bin/ln original twin
/usr/bin/mkfifo -m 0640 pipe
pax -w -f archive.tar original twin pipe
/usr/bin/tar -xf archive.tar -C restored
[[ restored/original -ef restored/twin && -p restored/pipe && $(<restored/original) == shared ]]
pax -w -f next.tar twin
/usr/bin/tar -xf next.tar -C one-member
[[ $(<one-member/twin) == shared ]]
printf 'pax writer links fifo and context verified\n'
cases.stdout: pax writer links fifo and context verified

cases.purpose: The shared pax reader extracts fixed independent FIFO metadata without opening a stream and preserves its normal pax mode contract despite umask077.
cases.script:
printf '%s' '' | /usr/bin/base64 -d > oracle.tar
/usr/bin/mkdir restored
umask 077
(cd restored; pax -r -f ../oracle.tar)
[[ -p restored/pipe && $(<restored/after) == 'fifo sibling' ]]
/usr/bin/stat -c %a restored/pipe restored/after
: > after-mask
/usr/bin/stat -c %a after-mask
